notes:
- **fix: Table Service — UI not updating after Send to Register / Recall** — `_tsOpenTab()` was called after both operations but the function does not exist; replaced with `_tsDrawTabView()` (which re-renders from the already-loaded `_tsCurrentTab`). Floor plan card now immediately shows the blue "AT REGISTER" state and action buttons switch to "Recall" after sending to register. (`web/static/js/table_service.js`)
- **fix: Table Service — fire-kitchen route returns 400 for config failures, not 500** — route now catches all unhandled exceptions as 500; `success=False` cases (no printer, printer not enabled) return 400 so the JS manual-confirm branch is triggered correctly. (`web/routes/table_service.py`)
- **fix: Table Service — manual kitchen confirm when no printer** — if fire-kitchen returns a non-ok response (400), JS shows a "Manual Kitchen Order" modal listing unsent items with a "Confirm Order Sent" button. Confirmation calls `POST /api/ts/tabs/<id>/confirm-kitchen` which bulk-marks all unsent items `sent_to_kitchen=1` without printing. Provides a workflow path for venues without a thermal printer. (`web/static/js/table_service.js`, `web/routes/table_service.py`, `core/table_service.py`)
- **fix: Table Service — GL rounding error on multi-line tabs** — two items at $9.09 produced an out-of-balance journal ($18.19 AR debit vs $16.52+$1.66=$18.18 credits). Caused by repeating-decimal ex-GST (9.09/1.1=8.2636̄) being passed directly to `save_invoice`; per-line GST rounded independently. Fixed by rounding `unit_price` to 2dp in `settle_tab()` before building the invoice lines. (`core/table_service.py`)
- **fix: Table Service — send-to-register double-stripped GST** — `ts_tab_items` stores ex-GST prices; POS always divides `unit_price` by 1.1 on sale submission. Cart JSON was written with ex-GST values → POS divided again → ~9% undercharge. Fixed by multiplying by 1.1 (for GST items) before writing to `cart_data.lines` in `send_tab_to_register()`. (`core/table_service.py`)
- **fix: Table Service — Send to Register blocked without active POS session** — route required a valid session ID; removed the guard so tabs can be sent to register even when no POS session is open. Parked cart is created with `session_id=null`; POS Held modal loads all carts regardless of session. (`web/static/js/table_service.js`)
- **fix: Table Service — tab stays "AT REGISTER" after POS payment** — POS had no mechanism to notify Table Service after settling a TS-originated cart. Added `_posLinkedTabId` module var in `pos.js`; set on resume from a DB cart with a `_tab_id` field; after a successful POS sale, calls `POST /api/ts/tabs/<id>/mark-settled` to update the tab status to Settled. New `mark_tab_settled()` core function and route added. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `core/table_service.py`, `web/routes/table_service.py`)
- **fix: Table Service — recall shows descriptive errors for non-Sent tabs** — previously returned a generic 400; now distinguishes "Tab has already been settled at the register" (status=Settled) from other invalid statuses. JS on recall failure reloads tab+tables and re-renders to auto-correct stale "AT REGISTER" UI. (`core/table_service.py`, `web/static/js/table_service.js`)
- **feat: Table Service Step 2** — DB-backed parked carts (`pos_parked_carts` table): park always writes to DB, held sales survive page reload; POS held modal loads DB carts (label, item count, total), resume deletes DB record. "Send to Register" button on Open tabs serialises tab items into a parked cart and sets `status='Sent'`; floor plan card turns blue (new `.ts-table-sent` CSS class). "Recall to Floor" button on Sent tabs deletes the parked cart and reopens the tab. Item add in Table Service now shows a note + qty modal before adding (note stored per line, printed on kitchen docket). Sold-out items show `.ts-item-tile-soldout` overlay and are non-clickable. `is_available` toggle added to Items module edit form and detail panel. Modifier group infrastructure: 4 new tables (`item_modifier_groups`, `item_modifier_options`, `item_modifier_group_links`, `ts_tab_item_modifiers`) created in migration, schema-only (no UI). `is_available` and `prompt_modifiers` columns added to `items` via safe ALTER TABLE. (`core/table_service.py`, `web/routes/table_service.py`, `web/static/js/table_service.js`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/js/items.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`, `core/database.py`, `core/items.py`)
- **feat: Table Service module** — new dine-in module for cafes/restaurants. Floor plan shows all tables as status cards (green = free, amber = occupied) with optional zone grouping. Staff tap a table to open a tab, add items via a searchable item picker (same catalogue as POS), fire a kitchen docket to the ESC/POS thermal printer, then settle via cash/card/account — reusing the existing POS payment flow and GL posting. Tabs are stored as staged orders (`ts_tab_items`); settlement calls `create_pos_sale()` so GL journals, invoices, and pos_sales records are created identically to counter sales. Shared POS session — both POS counter and Table Service contribute to the same Z-report; two tablets can run simultaneously (floor + counter). Auto-refresh every 30 s keeps the floor plan in sync across devices. Admin view for zone and table CRUD. Kitchen docket fires only unsent items; `sent_to_kitchen` flag tracked per line. 4 new DB tables migrated via `migrate_table_service()`. (`core/table_service.py`, `web/routes/table_service.py`, `web/static/js/table_service.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/server.py`, `core/database.py`)
- **feat: POS barcode scan mode** — "⊙ Scan" toggle button in POS search bar. When on: global `keydown` listener buffers rapid keystrokes (resets on >80ms gap) and fires barcode lookup on Enter — matches by `barcode` field then `code`; skips when a modal is open or another input is focused. Also: pressing Enter in the search input always attempts an exact barcode/code match regardless of scan mode. On match: clears search, adds item (increments qty if already in cart), flashes the tile with an accent glow animation, shows "Added: {name}" toast. On no match: error toast with the scanned code. `data-id` attribute added to `.pos-tile` for querySelector targeting. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Z-report modal scrollable** — `pos-zrpt-modal` now has `max-height:90vh`, `display:flex; flex-direction:column`, and `overflow:hidden`; `modal-body` inside gets `flex:1; overflow-y:auto` so long reports (banking section, denomination counts) scroll within the viewport. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS end-of-day email summary** — when a POS session is closed, a plain-text Z-report is automatically emailed if the feature is enabled. New `eod_email_enabled` and `eod_email_address` columns in `pos_settings`; `_send_eod_email()` in `core/pos.py` formats the report (tender breakdown, totals, cash counted, variance, banking) and sends it via the existing SMTP config; failure never blocks the session close. Toggle checkbox + email address field added to the "End-of-Day Email" section in POS Settings. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `core/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: POS category + visibility fields not appearing** — fields were added to `inventory.js` (`_stkEditSettings`) but the user edits items through the Items module (`items.js`). Added POS section (visibility checkbox + category input) to `_showItmModal()` and `saveItem()` in `items.js`; also added POS row to `renderItmDetail()` so current values are visible in the detail panel. (`web/static/js/items.js`)
- **feat: POS item categories + visibility flag** — `pos_category TEXT` and `pos_visible INTEGER DEFAULT 1` added to `items` table via safe `ALTER TABLE` (existing items default visible). POS tile grid now filters out items where `pos_visible=0`. Category bar in POS uses `pos_category` if set, falling back to `account_name`, so groups are user-editable without touching chart of accounts. Both fields appear in Inventory → ⚙ Edit Settings under a new "POS" section. (`core/items.py`, `core/pos.py`, `web/routes/inventory.py`, `web/static/js/inventory.js`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: POS analytics modal** — "Analytics" button in cart header opens a two-tab modal. Analytics tab: date-range picker (Today / Last 7 Days / This Month presets), 4 stat cards (Total Revenue, Transactions, Avg Sale, GST Collected), CSS vertical bar chart for daily revenue, top-10 items with inline revenue bars, 24-cell hourly heatmap using `color-mix`. Staff tab: sales table by operator with sessions, transactions, revenue, avg sale, and grand-total footer. New `/api/pos/analytics` and `/api/pos/staff-report` routes. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: NOTES.md** — marked Held Transactions as complete in Tier 1 table.
- **feat: POS summary report** — "Summary Report" button in Session History modal; preset buttons (Today / Last 7 Days / This Month) + manual date range; aggregates cash/card/split/account totals across sessions; per-session breakdown table. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS held transactions** — Park button saves current cart (lines, customer, basket discount) to in-memory parked list; Held (N) button opens modal listing parked sales with Resume and Delete; Resume offers Park & Resume or Discard & Resume when a cart is already active. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS basket discount** — `% Discount` input in the cart totals block; entering a value shows a savings row and updates TOTAL + all tender button amounts live; passed to server as `discount_type='percent'` so `save_invoice` handles proportional GST reduction correctly; reset on cart clear and after every sale. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS on-account sales** — "Account" tender button appears in POS when the selected customer has the Approved Account flag set. Confirmation modal (no cash entry); `create_pos_sale()` skips `record_payment()` and leaves invoice Sent in AR. Z-report shows account row in amber, excluded from TOTAL SALES. Sales history filter + table label handle 'account'. (`core/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Approved Account flag on contacts** — `approved_account` + `approved_by_employee_id` columns on contacts; checkbox + employee select in contact edit form; "Approved" badge in list and detail panel. (`core/database.py`, `core/ledger.py`, `web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/static/js/contacts.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS custom receipt footer** — free-text "Receipt Footer Message" field in POS Settings replaces the hardcoded "Thank you for your business!" on thermal receipts. Applied to sale, refund, and credit note receipts. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `core/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: POS search bar buttons clipped at non-full-screen widths** — Drawer and Gear buttons were pushed off the right edge and clipped by `overflow:hidden` on `.pos-items-panel`. Fixed by adding `min-width:0` to `.pos-search-inp` (allows input to shrink) and `flex-shrink:0` to `.pos-gear-btn`. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS line-level % discount** — discount % input on each cart line; recalculates total + GST instantly; discounted unit price sent to server on sale submission. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: POS GST double-counted** — items are stored GST-inclusive but `save_invoice` expects ex-GST; `_posSubmitSale` now divides unit_price by 1.1 for GST items before sending to server so the invoice total matches the cart total. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: POS email receipt button never appeared** — `_posSubmitSale` cleared `_posContactId` before `_posShowReceipt` could read it; contact email is now captured before state is cleared and passed through `result.contactEmail`. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: POS email receipt** — "Email Receipt" button on sale complete modal when selected customer has an email address; contact email shown as hint; POSTs to existing `/api/invoices/<id>/email`; button shows ✓ Sent on success. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS customer picker — multi-field search + create contact** — search by name, phone, email, address, or city; phone/email sub-line shown in results; "+ New Contact" button opens inline create form (name, phone, email, address) without leaving POS. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
